title: GLM example scheduler experiment
summary: Fictional custom image that tests one scheduler-bound change against the recommended community image.

base_image.credit: Fictional Local Inference Lab maintainers and contributors

recommended_image.relationship: Recommended support and comparison control for the GLM example family

community_wiki.relationship: Community wiki landing page used to locate current model-family guidance; this record remains a fictional format example.

pull_requests.title: Bound the fictional scheduler diagnostic queue

inherited: The recommended base supplies the fictional GLM serving profile, B12X kernels, and target-only launcher.
introduced: The scheduler diagnostic snapshot is capped at 1,024 entries.
compatibility_impact: Diagnostic clients receive no more than 1,024 pending entries; serving admission behavior is unchanged.

tested_configurations.name: Four fictional Blackwell GPUs, target-only
tested_configurations.hardware: 4 x fictional SM120 GPUs with 96 GiB each
tested_configurations.topology: Single-socket PCIe topology; peer access enabled
tested_configurations.speculative_mode: Disabled; no MTP, external draft, or n-gram speculation
tested_configurations.cache_policy: Fresh dedicated JIT volume for candidate and a separate fresh volume for baseline
tested_configurations.launch_command: docker run --rm --gpus all --network host -e TP=4 -e MAX_NUM_SEQS=30 -e CUDAGRAPH_MODE=FULL registry.example.org/community/vllm:glm-example-scheduler-r1@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

results.name: Image startup
results.conditions: Fresh container and dedicated JIT volume.
results.result: Server reached healthy state and completed one request.
results.conclusion: The tested image starts under the listed configuration.

results.name: Scheduler regression checks
results.conditions: Clean source tree at the listed result tree.
results.conclusion: The diagnostic bound preserves tested short-queue behavior.

results.name: Thirty-request stability run
results.measurement: Thirty concurrent requests repeated three times.
results.conclusion: No instability was observed in the tested stress configuration.

results.name: Target-only decode regression
results.conditions: Candidate and recommended control on the same hardware with separate fresh JIT volumes.
results.measurement: Five independent 30-second runs at concurrency 1, 4, 16, and 30.
results.result: Candidate aggregate decode remained within 1.2% of the recommended control across tested cells.
results.conclusion: No material target-only decode regression was observed under the listed configuration.

performance_claims.name: Target-only decode parity
performance_claims.hardware: 4 x fictional SM120 GPUs; identical power and clocks
performance_claims.experimental_unit: One independently started and warmed server process on the fixed four-GPU host
performance_claims.run_order: Predeclared randomized ten-run order with five candidate and five control server starts
performance_claims.stopping_rule: Five independently started server runs per image
performance_claims.exclusions: None; failed runs would remain in the raw evidence
performance_claims.aggregation: Median aggregate tokens/second per cell; every run retained
performance_claims.falsification_condition: A reproducible per-cell regression outside repeated-control variation
performance_claims.absolute_effect: Candidate minus control ranged from -14 to +9 aggregate tokens/second across tested cells
performance_claims.relative_effect: Candidate minus control ranged from -1.2% to +0.7%; every tested cell was within 1.2% of control
performance_claims.uncertainty: Across five independent runs per image, per-cell median absolute deviation was 0.3% to 0.8%; no population-level interval was claimed
performance_claims.result: All tested cells were within 1.2% of the control.
performance_claims.conclusion: The diagnostic-only change did not materially affect target-only decode on the tested system.

known: This is a fictional documentation example and is not a runnable image.
untested: Other GPU counts, SGLang, speculative decoding, and models outside the example family were Not tested.
unsupported: Production use of this fictional image is unsupported.

support.triage_policy: Keep reports in this thread. Escalate upstream only after reproduction on the current recommended image under an equivalent configuration or a minimal reproducer identifies the responsible source change.
